subject: maths
question: If the number of school going children in a town is 64000 and it is increasing annually by 10%, then what will be the number of school going children in the town at the end of 3 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Number of school-going children (N) = 64,000

Annual increase rate (r) = 10%

Time (t) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Number of children at the end of 3 years = N × (1 + r/100)t
